items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...That's the reason why Nat should have played piano for him. [INTERVIEWEE] Yes.

ctx.x: There is some rumor that he may have played on some early records of Eddie Cole. They were made about that time. Eddie Cole also was a piano player, wasn't he? Oh, yes. That's the reason why Nat should have played piano for him.
